decision.reason: not-allowed: The author disclaims all warranties with regard to this software,

explanation: The Lucent notice matches HPND, but the Gay (2007) and AMPL (2002-2014) notices omit the HPND name clause, so they are not the listed text. Under the closed list and the rule to refuse when in doubt, the file is refused; the maintainer must decide whether these variants count.
